topic: Graphs of Sine, Cosine and Tangent
title: Circle to Wave! Trig Graphs Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Tie a pen to a tyre valve and pull a sheet of paper past the turning wheel. What shape does the pen draw? Aarav pictures it on his ride home: a smooth wave. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 3, Trigonometric Functions) we draw the graphs of sin x, cos x and tan x from the unit circle.

You will watch the height of P carried across from the unit circle while y = sin x draws itself live, plot the five key points, see y = cos x come from the side-to-side position of P (the sine wave slid left by pi/2), and watch tan x climb, shoot up and break at an asymptote. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example that counts the solutions of sin x = 1/2 with a graph, the exam trap about joining the tangent graph, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
0:00 A pen on a tyre valve
0:24 Live: the sine wave from the unit circle
0:57 Five key points
1:33 The cosine wave
1:55 Sine vs cosine: side by side
2:23 The tangent graph and its asymptotes
3:28 Worked example: how many solutions of sin x = 1/2?
3:57 Exam trap: never join the tangent pieces
4:13 Where it is asked
4:19 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
4:49 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 31): Periodicity and Symmetry. A heartbeat on a monitor repeats the same shape, and so does sin x.
